lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਪਿਰਹਿ ਮੇਲਾ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan pirahi melaa hoi suaamee aap prabh kirapaa kare ||
lines.translation: The soul-bride meets her Husband Lord, when the Lord Master Himself showers His favor upon her.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਜਾ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਸਾਤ ਸਰ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sejaa suhaavee sa(n)g pir kai saat sar a(n)mrit bhare ||
lines.translation: Her bed is decorated in the company of her Beloved, and her seven pools are filled with ambrosial nectar.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਮਇਆ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar daiaa maiaa daiaal saache sabad mil gun gaavao ||
lines.translation: Be kind and compassionate to me, O Merciful True Lord, that I may obtain the Word of the Shabad, and sing Your Glorious Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਬਿਗਸੀ ਮੁੰਧ ਮਨਿ ਓਮਾਹਓ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanakaa har var dekh bigasee mu(n)dh man omaahao ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, gazing upon her Husband Lord, the soul-bride is delighted, and her mind is filled with joy. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਧ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਲੋਨੜੀਏ ਇਕ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: mu(n)dh sahaj salonaReee ik prem bina(n)tee raam ||
lines.translation: O bride of natural beauty, offer your loving prayers to the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਮਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai man tan har bhaavai prabh sa(n)gam raatee raam ||
lines.translation: The Lord is pleasing to my mind and body; I am intoxicated in my Lord God's Company.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh prem raatee har bina(n)tee naam har kai sukh vasai ||
lines.translation: Imbued with the Love of God, I pray to the Lord, and through the Lord's Name, I abide in peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਗੁਣ ਪਛਾਣਹਿ ਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਗੁਣਹ ਵਸਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਨਸੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tau gun pachhaanahi taa prabh jaanahi gunah vas avagan nasai ||
lines.translation: If you recognize His Glorious Virtues, then you shall come to know God; thus virtue shall dwell in you, and sin shall run away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਾਝੁ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਾ ਕਹਣਿ ਸੁਨਣਿ ਨ ਧੀਜਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: tudh baajh ik til rahi na saakaa kahan sunan na dheejae ||
lines.translation: Without You, I cannot survive, even for an instant; by merely talking and listening about You, I am not satisfied.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਪੁਕਾਰੇ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਿ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜਏ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanakaa priu priu kar pukaare rasan ras man bheejae ||2||
lines.translation: Nanak proclaims, "O Beloved, O Beloved!" His tongue and mind are drenched with the Lord's sublime essence. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਖੀਹੋ ਸਹੇਲੜੀਹੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: sakheeho sahelaReeho meraa pir vanajaaraa raam ||
lines.translation: O my companions and friends, my Husband Lord is the merchant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋੁ ਵਣੰਜੜਿਆ ਰਸਿ ਮੋਲਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: har naamou vana(n)jaRiaa ras mol apaaraa raam ||
lines.translation: I have purchased the Lord's Name; its sweetness and value are unlimited.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਲਿ ਅਮੋਲੋ ਸਚ ਘਰਿ ਢੋਲੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਮੁੰਧ ਭਲੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: mol amolo sach ghar dholo prabh bhaavai taa mu(n)dh bhalee ||
lines.translation: His value is invaluable; the Beloved dwells in His true home. If it is pleasing to God, then He blesses His bride.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਕਰਹਿ ਰਲੀਆ ਹਉ ਪੁਕਾਰੀ ਦਰਿ ਖਲੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik sa(n)g har kai karahi raleeaa hau pukaaree dar khalee ||
lines.translation: Some enjoy sweet pleasures with the Lord, while I stand crying at His door.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਆਪਿ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਾਰਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: karan kaaran samarath sreedhar aap kaaraj saarae ||
lines.translation: The Creator, the Cause of causes, the All-powerful Lord Himself arranges our affairs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਧਨ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਭ ਸਾਧਾਰਏ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak nadaree dhan sohaagan sabad abh saadhaarae ||3||
lines.translation: O Nanak, blessed is the soul-bride, upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace; she enshrines the Word of the Shabad in her heart. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਘਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸੋਹਿਲੜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਇਅੜੇ ਮੀਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham ghar saachaa sohilaRaa prabh aaiaRe meetaa raam ||
lines.translation: In my home, the true songs of rejoicing resound; the Lord God, my Friend, has come to me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਵੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੜਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਅੜਾ ਦੀਤਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: raave ra(n)g raataRiaa man leeaRaa deetaa raam ||
lines.translation: He enjoys me, and imbued with His Love, I have captivated His heart, and given mine to Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਣਾ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਲੀਆ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਵਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapanaa man deeaa har var leeaa jiu bhaavai tiu raavae ||
lines.translation: I gave my mind, and obtained the Lord as my Husband; as it pleases His Will, He enjoys me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਆਗੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਭਾਗੈ ਘਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: tan man pir aagai sabad sabhaagai ghar a(n)mrit phal paavae ||
lines.translation: I have placed my body and mind before my Husband Lord, and through the Shabad, I have been blessed. Within the home of my own self, I have obtained the ambrosial fruit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਠਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਹੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈਐ ਭਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: budh paath na paaeeai bahu chaturaaeeai bhaai milai man bhaane ||
lines.translation: He is not obtained by intellectual recitation or great cleverness; only by love does the mind obtain Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮੀਤ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਹਮ ਨਾਹੀ ਲੋਕਾਣੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak thaakur meet hamaare ham naahee lokaane ||4||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Lord Master is my Best Friend; I am not an ordinary person. ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦੋ ਅਨਹਦੁ ਵਾਜੈ ਰੁਣ ਝੁਣਕਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: anahado anahad vaajai run jhunakaare raam ||
lines.translation: The unstruck melody of the sound current resounds with the vibrations of the celestial instruments.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਲਾਲ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: meraa mano meraa man raataa laal piaare raam ||
lines.translation: My mind, my mind is imbued with the Love of my Darling Beloved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਸੁੰਨ ਮੰਡਲਿ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadin raataa man bairaagee su(n)n ma(n)dal ghar paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Night and day, my detached mind remains absorbed in the Lord, and I obtain my home in the profound trance of the celestial void.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aad purakh apara(n)par piaaraa satigur alakh lakhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The True Guru has revealed to me the Primal Lord, the Infinite, my Beloved, the Unseen.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਣਿ ਬੈਸਣਿ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasan baisan thir naaraain tit man raataa veechaare ||
lines.translation: The Lord's posture and His seat are permanent; my mind is absorbed in reflective contemplation upon Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਅਨਹਦ ਰੁਣ ਝੁਣਕਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam rate bairaagee anahad run jhunakaare ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the detached ones are imbued with His Name, the unstruck melody, and the celestial vibrations. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਅਗਮ ਤਿਤੁ ਅਗਮ ਪੁਰੇ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: tit agam tit agam pure kahu kit bidh jaaeeai raam ||
lines.translation: Tell me, how can I reach that unreachable, that unreachable city?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੋ ਸਾਰਿ ਗੁਣਾ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach sa(n)jamo saar gunaa gurasabad kamaaeeai raam ||
lines.translation: By practicing truthfulness and self-restraint, by contemplating His Glorious Virtues, and living the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach sabad kamaaeeai nij ghar jaaeeai paaeeai gunee nidhaanaa ||
lines.translation: Practicing the True Word of the Shabad, one comes to the home of his own inner being, and obtains the treasure of virtue.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਸਾਖਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਪਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਡਾਲੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਪਰਧਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tit saakhaa mool pat nahee daalee sir sabhanaa paradhaanaa ||
lines.translation: He has no stems, roots, leaves or branches, but He is the Supreme Lord over the heads of all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਜਮ ਥਾਕੀ ਹਠਿ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jap tap kar kar sa(n)jam thaakee hath nigrahi nahee paaeeai ||
lines.translation: Practicing intensive meditation, chanting and self-discipline, people have grown weary; stubbornly practicing these rituals, they still have not found Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sahaj mile jagajeevan satigur boojh bujhaaeeai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, through spiritual wisdom, the Lord, the Life of the world, is met; the True Guru imparts this understanding. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੋ ਰਤਨਾਗਰੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਰਤਨ ਘਣੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur saagaro ratanaagar tit ratan ghanere raam ||
lines.translation: The Guru is the ocean, the mountain of jewels, overflowing with jewels.
